title: Intro
text: Welcome to Science Radar, your weekly digest of the most surprising, frontier-pushing, and cross-disciplinary discoveries from across all of science. This week we've found papers that challenge long-held assumptions, open doors to entirely new research directions, and connect ideas across fields in ways nobody expected. Let's dive in.

title: Precision oncology’s translation gap—Can molecular tumor boards bridge it?
text:
Precision oncology’s translation gap—Can molecular tumor boards bridge it? — PLOS Medicine.

by Margaret M. Byrne, Jill M. Kolesar

Precision oncology is revolutionizing cancer care, but isn’t reaching enough patients. Molecular tumor boards (MTBs) translate complex genomic data to more effectively inform personalized care, and a new meta-analysis shows they boost clinical outcomes.

title: Outro

Every one of these papers is a reminder that the most interesting science often lives at the edges — where fields collide, where assumptions break, and where the next big question is just starting to take shape. Until next week, keep questioning everything.
